async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Built-in 30' link to expand and view all built-in templates
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Built-in 30").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Select the Android template from the expanded list
    # Based on the tree, templates have 'Use template' radio buttons; find Android by name
    android_radio = page.get_by_role("radio", name="Android")
    await android_radio.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Fill in the project name
    await page.get_by_label("Project name").fill("web_agent_android_xl")
    
    # Set project visibility to private
    await page.get_by_role("radio", name="Private").click()
    
    # Create the project
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Create project").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # After project creation, navigate to project settings to add members
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Settings").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Members").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Add each member
    members = ["primer", "convexegg", "abishek"]
    for member in members:
        await page.get_by_placeholder("Search by name, username, or email").fill(member)
        await page.keyboard.press("Enter")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for search results
        # Assuming there's an 'Add' button next to the user
        add_button = page.get_by_role("button", name=f"Add {member}", exact=False).or_(page.get_by_role("button", name="Add", exact=False))
        await add_button.click()
        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
    
    return "Project 'web_agent_android_xl' created with Android template and members added."
